cli.description: Autonomous scheduling skill: plan analyzes requirements interactively, run executes silently, report wraps up

common.noPool: ❌ No task pool. Run nightowl init first

init.skipPermissionsOption: Skip permission request, only initialize task pool
init.tplSkipped: ⚠️  {{dst}} already exists and is locally customized, skipped (--force overwrites)
init.tplMissing: ❌ Template missing in package, cannot install: {{dst}}
init.gitignoreWritten: 📝 .gitignore {{action}}: {{entries}} (otherwise worktree misreads harness state as uncommitted changes)

add.ok: ✅ Added. Run nightowl status to view.

status.title: 📊 Task pool status ({{n}} tasks)
status.skillsUnversioned: 💡 Project skills have no recorded source version (old init output); re-run nightowl init to fill it in
status.skillsOutdated: 💡 Project skills v{{installed}} < current package v{{latest}}; run nightowl init to re-install

done.requireCommitOption: Enforce the main branch has a [#id] commit (default: new platforms block, Claude warns)
done.noReview: ❌ {{id}} has not been code-reviewed, refusing to mark done.
done.noReviewHint: Run nightowl review <id> --result PASS first, or use --force to skip
done.reviewFail: ❌ {{id}} code review failed (FAIL), refusing to mark done.
done.reviewFailHint: Re-review as PASS after fixing, or use --force to skip
done.noVerify: ❌ {{id}} has not passed verification (verify), refusing to mark done.
done.noVerifyHint: Run nightowl verify <id> first, or use --force to skip
done.noCommit: ❌ {{id}}: no commit with [#{{id}}] found on the main branch, refusing to mark done.
done.noCommitHint: Confirm the implementer committed with `[#{{id}}]` in the message and merged to the main branch; or use --force to skip
done.noCommitWarn: ⚠️  {{id}}: no commit with [#{{id}}] on the main branch (ensure implemented + merged; Claude platform warns only, does not block)
done.prdBackfilled: 📄 PRD backfilled by done: checked {{n}} acceptance command(s) with execution receipts
done.prdBackfillSkipped: 📄 PRD backfill skipped ({{reason}}); task state unaffected

verify.noHead: ⚠️ {{id}} passed but git HEAD unavailable (dir: {{cwd}}); receipt is not bound to a code version and worktree merge stale-check will not apply.

commit.desc: Commit with task conventions (auto-adds [#<id>], disables interactive signing/editor)
commit.taskOption: Task ID (the commit message is bound to it)
commit.messageOption: Commit message (no need to write [#<id>]; the CLI prepends it)
commit.allOption: Run git add -A before committing (default: staged changes only)
commit.signOption: Keep GPG signing (default is --no-gpg-sign to avoid unattended passphrase prompts)
commit.detached:
❌ Detached HEAD: the commit would be orphaned
   ↪ Next: git switch <branch> and retry
commit.inProgress:
❌ Unfinished {{op}} in progress; finish it before committing
   ↪ Next: merge: git merge --abort; rebase: git rebase --abort
commit.noIdentity:
❌ Git commit identity (user.name / user.email) not configured
   ↪ Next: git config user.name "<name>" && git config user.email "<email>"
commit.wrongTask:
❌ The message already contains another task marker [#{{found}}], which conflicts with --task {{id}}
   ↪ Next: remove that marker (the CLI will add [#{{id}}])
commit.nothing:
❌ Nothing to commit (only staged changes are committed by default)
   ↪ Next: git add <file> or nightowl commit --task {{id}} -m "..." --all

analyze.title: 🔍 Project documentation analysis
analyze.written: 💡 Project context written to {{file}}, implementing subagents read it before acting

sweep.cleanOption: Actually remove residual worktrees that are merged and clean (default: report only)
sweep.branchKeep:
⚠️ Worktree removed, but branch {{branch}} was kept (unmerged commits remain):
{{err}}

push.title: 🚀 Pushing unpushed commits
push.noRemote: ⚠️ No git remote configured, skipping push
push.noRemoteSelected:
❌ Multiple remotes but no clear push target (branch: {{branch}}, remotes: {{remotes}})
   ↪ Next: git branch --set-upstream-to=<remote>/{{branch}}
push.detached:
❌ Detached HEAD, cannot push automatically
   ↪ Next: git switch <branch> and retry

preflight.title: 🩺 nightowl preflight
preflight.strictOption: Treat warnings as failures (recommended before unattended runs)
preflight.summaryFail: ❌ Environment check failed: {{n}} item(s) to fix

ok.shallow: Repository is not a shallow clone

warn.dirty: Working tree has {{n}} uncommitted change(s); merge requires a clean tree
warn.shallow: Shallow clone: merge-base/ancestry checks may be wrong
warn.worktrees: {{n}} worktree directory/directories no longer exist (stale metadata)
warn.ignored: .nightowl/ is not git-ignored; state files may be committed by mistake
warn.remote: No git remote configured; push will be skipped

fail.repo: Not inside a git repository (worktree/commit operations unavailable)
fail.branch: Detached HEAD: merge commits would be orphaned
fail.identity: Git commit identity (user.name / user.email) not configured

fix.merge: merge: git merge --abort; rebase: git rebase --abort; then commit the resolution
fix.identity: git config user.name "<name>" && git config user.email "<email>"
fix.dirty: git status; commit or git stash

report.title: # 📊 nightowl Report
report.deviationLine: > **Effort deviation**: est {{est}}m / actual {{actual}}m ({{pct}}) | review rejects: {{fails}} | nits: {{nits}}
report.estimateLine: > **Effort estimate**: total est {{est}}m | review rejects: {{fails}} | nits: {{nits}}
report.reasonReady: All expected tasks verified and reviewed
report.reasonP0: P0 tasks are not all complete ({{done}}/{{total}})
report.reasonReview: {{n}} review rejection round(s); inspect the rework
report.tableHeader: | Task | Owner | Priority | Est | Actual | Status |

permissions.already: ℹ️ {{target}} already contains all nightowl permission rules, no change needed
permissions.reload: 💡 Reload: restart the session to apply
permissions.noninteractive: 💡 Run non-interactively in the run phase (no prompts at all): launch with permission-free mode: {{cmd}}
permissions.hookInstalled: 🔧 PreToolUse hook configured (records permission mode to .nightowl/.permission-mode): {{target}}

selfcheck.desc: Check current session permission mode (bypass detection)
selfcheck.bypass: ✅ Permission mode is bypass: run can execute silently.
selfcheck.notBypass: ⚠️ Permission mode is not bypass ({{mode}}): run needs a permission-free launch (`{{cmd}}`), or switch to bypass and restart the session so the hook records it.
selfcheck.unknown: ❓ Cannot detect permission mode (no hook, no process signal). Run `nightowl init` to install the PreToolUse hook and restart, or launch in permission-free mode per platform.

supervise.desc: Unattended main-session driver: repeatedly launches the host headless session to continue run, exits when the pool completes
supervise.maxIdleOption: consecutive idle-round limit (default 3, stop when reached)
supervise.onceOption: run exactly one round then exit
supervise.noHeadless: ❌ Platform {{platform}} does not support unattended driving yet (headlessRun not implemented)
supervise.doneBlocked: ✅ run complete: {{done}}/{{total}} tasks done ({{n}} blocked), exiting
supervise.deadlock: ⚠️ {{n}} tasks left unschedulable (dependencies unmet), run not complete (check deps/blocked tasks), exiting
supervise.finalizeRound: 🧹 All business tasks done but report not written yet, launching a finalize round to generate it
supervise.finalizeFail: ⚠️ Finalize round failed, report may be missing (run nightowl report to fill it)
supervise.roundStart: 🔄 Round {{round}}: driving main session ({{remaining}} tasks left)
supervise.infraError: ❌ Fatal infrastructure error: {{error}}, stopping supervisor and preserving tasks without consuming the task retry budget
supervise.fallback: ↪ --continue failed, falling back to a fresh session without --continue
supervise.blockFail: ❌ Session failed {{attempt}} rounds in a row, blocking task {{id}}
supervise.blockReason: supervise session failed {{attempt}} rounds in a row
supervise.idleStop: ⏹ No progress for {{n}} consecutive rounds, stopping (if a task is mid-implementation, raise --max-idle or rerun supervise to resume)
supervise.idle: 🕐 This round made no progress ({{idleRounds}}/{{maxIdle}} idle rounds)

workflow.generateDesc: Generate a workflow from intent, template or YAML; replace the pool by default
workflow.applyOption: Replace the task pool, keeping the independent execution state (default)
workflow.noApplyOption: Save/validate the workflow without changing the task pool or execution state
workflow.listDesc: List saved workflow stages, agents, tasks and dependencies
workflow.noWorkflow: WORKFLOW_NOT_FOUND: No saved workflow at {{file}}; run nightowl workflow generate <file> or use --intent / --template
workflow.applied: ✅ Task pool replaced: {{file}} (independent execution state unchanged)
workflow.notApplied: ℹ️ --no-apply: task pool and independent execution state unchanged
workflow.listHeader: ID	Stage	Agent	Tasks	Depends on stages
workflow.unknownStage: WORKFLOW_UNKNOWN_STAGE: Stage {{id}} depends on unknown stage {{dep}}
workflow.unknownTask: WORKFLOW_UNKNOWN_TASK: Task {{id}} depends on unknown task {{dep}}
workflow.cycleStage: WORKFLOW_STAGE_CYCLE: Stage dependencies cannot be resolved (cycle): {{ids}}
workflow.cycleTask: WORKFLOW_TASK_CYCLE: Task dependencies cannot be resolved (cycle): {{ids}}
workflow.intentOption: Requirement intent (Chinese/English); infer a workflow template
workflow.templateOption: Explicit template: feature, bugfix, refactor, audit (overrides inference)
workflow.sourceConflict: WORKFLOW_SOURCE_CONFLICT: file cannot be combined with --intent or --template; choose one source
workflow.emptyIntent: WORKFLOW_EMPTY_INTENT: --intent must contain non-empty requirement text
workflow.unknownTemplate: WORKFLOW_UNKNOWN_TEMPLATE: Unknown workflow template {{template}}; choose from: {{choices}}
workflow.selectedTemplate: ℹ️ Workflow template: {{template}} (scaffold; check project gates before execution)

stageDescriptions.design: Inspect existing contracts and define scope, design and acceptance criteria for: {{intent}}.
stageDescriptions.implement: Implement the approved design incrementally with focused tests for: {{intent}}.
stageDescriptions.verify: Verify acceptance criteria and positive, negative and boundary cases for: {{intent}}.
stageDescriptions.review: Independently inspect changes and evidence; do not self-approve implementation for: {{intent}}.
stageDescriptions.diagnose: Reproduce the failure and record root-cause evidence before fixing: {{intent}}.
stageDescriptions.fix: Apply the smallest root-cause fix and add a test that fails before the fix: {{intent}}.
stageDescriptions.regression: Run the targeted regression and existing tests; verify preserved behavior for: {{intent}}.
stageDescriptions.baseline: Record existing behavior, contracts and passing test evidence before refactoring: {{intent}}.
stageDescriptions.refactor: Restructure incrementally without changing external behavior or contracts: {{intent}}.
stageDescriptions.inspect: Read code, configuration and tests; record file/line evidence without remediation: {{intent}}.
stageDescriptions.report: Report prioritized findings, evidence and recommendations; do not implement fixes: {{intent}}.

stageAcceptance.design: Scope, solution and executable acceptance checks are documented and approved.
stageAcceptance.implement: Approved scope is implemented; type checks and targeted tests pass.
stageAcceptance.verify: Acceptance, failure and boundary cases have passing machine-verifiable evidence.
stageAcceptance.review: Independent review records evidence and no unresolved blocking findings remain.
stageAcceptance.diagnose: A reproducible failure and evidence-backed root cause are recorded.
stageAcceptance.fix: The failure is fixed at its root and a regression test demonstrates the fix.
stageAcceptance.regression: Targeted regression and existing tests pass without behavioral regressions.
stageAcceptance.baseline: Existing contracts and a passing test baseline are recorded before modification.
stageAcceptance.refactor: External behavior and contracts remain unchanged; baseline checks pass.
stageAcceptance.inspect: Audit scope and file/line evidence are recorded without source remediation.
stageAcceptance.report: Findings include severity, evidence and recommendations; no fixes are applied.
